name: Bronchiectasis
description: A chronic lung condition in which damaged airways become abnormally widened and have impaired mucus clearance, predisposing to persistent sputum production, recurrent infections and repeated exacerbations.
risk_factors: Previous severe or recurrent respiratory infections
physical_examination: Signs of hypoxemia or respiratory compromise in advanced disease
recommended_investigations: Sputum culture including evaluation for clinically relevant bacterial or mycobacterial infection
Blood tests for infection and possible underlying causes
Further etiologic testing such as cystic fibrosis or immune evaluation when clinically indicated
red_flags: Sepsis or rapidly worsening systemic illness
contraindications: Do not rely on a normal or non-diagnostic chest X-ray alone to exclude bronchiectasis; CT is the key confirmatory imaging test.
